description: OBB -> AABB: out[0..2]=max xyz, out[4..6]=min xyz (out[3]/[7] untouched) via 6 support directions x 3 axes = 54 calls to Vec3Dot/Vec4Scale/Vec4AddInPlace; ~6-8% of KIDSTaskScheduler0; patch AABB (SIMD cave, bit-identical) in re/scripts_logic/logic_live.fsx. name: Vec4AddInPlace
signature: f32* Vec4AddInPlace(f32* a, const f32* b)

name: Vec4Scale
signature: f32* Vec4Scale(const f32* v, f32* out, f32 s)
description: out[i] = s * v[i] (4 lanes), returns out. Better name for existing row Sched0Hot_6F010

name: Vec3Dot
signature: f32 Vec3Dot(const f32* a, const f32* b)
description: ((a.y*b.y)+(a.x*b.x))+(a.z*b.z); no .pdata (leaf). Better name for existing row Sched0Hot_6F060

name: Vec4Set3
signature: f32* Vec4Set3(f32* out, f32 x, f32 y, f32 z)
description: out = (x, y, z, 0), returns out; no .pdata (leaf)

Only caller FE3AC0. Better name for existing row Sched0Hot_12B440

name: RollingAvgList_SumLoop
